title: Choose the article layout
question: Which reading structure should Vartifact use for article pages?

options.label: Reading Ledger
options.lineage: editorial ledgers and annotated proof sheets
options.thesis: The article opens as a precise reading record with a useful marginal index.
options.viewport: A compact cover and metadata ledger share the first fold while the article text starts immediately.
options.risk: The utility rail can feel administrative if it becomes too dense.

options.label: Film Leader
options.lineage: 35 mm leaders and editorial contact strips
options.thesis: A numbered film edge turns the article into a deliberate sequence of frames.
options.viewport: The title sits beside a narrow numbered rail and a cinematic cover strip, then flows into a calm reading column.
options.risk: The film rail must stay restrained so it does not compete with the prose.

options.label: Folded Contact Print
options.lineage: folded art journals and offset contact prints
options.thesis: Overlapping paper and image planes make the opening feel tactile and editorial.
options.viewport: An offset title sheet overlaps the cover while the opening paragraph peeks into the first fold.
options.risk: The layered composition needs strict responsive rules to stay readable on small screens.
